notes.f2: Not recovered on the subject. The agent found the correct father's name -- Sostenes Cruz -- via a genuine 1941 Paracuaro marriage investigation file (record_search hit, then record_read, then extraction_append), and wrote a ParentChild relationship. But that relationship (R1) connects I2 (Sostenes Cruz) to I1, a brand-new stub person, not to PID-TODO (the actual research subject). PID-TODO has zero relationships in the final tree, identical to the starting tree. same_person and merge_warnings were both called before the tree_edit, so the agent ran the identity-check machinery, but no merge of I1 into PID-TODO ever happened -- either an unresolved identity call (the stub's ~1912 birth year and a later 1930-census ~1914 hit both diverge from the subject's existing ~1910) or a skipped merge step. Escalated to the lead given the right name was found but never attached to the subject; ruling: false, since the required relationship does not exist on the tree's own subject regardless of the underlying evidence quality.
